topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 18 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (mixinaddressresolver, proxyable, mixinaccesscontrol). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
